rows.en: Yamato: "Oh, it looks like we have visitors."
Sisk: "I'm not the one who needs to see you.
Come on, what are you waiting for?"
Sisk: "There's no need to get shy after coming this far."
Ymir: "Hey, you don't need to pull me. I'm coming in."
Ymir: "I tried making a packed lunch...
Would you eat it, if you'd like?"
Touya: "A packed lunch? You made it, Ymir?"
Sisk: "I trained her thoroughly, so the taste is guaranteed."
You'll eat it, of course, right?"
Why would I turn it down?
Sorry, I'm not hungry right now.
Touya: "Yeah. You worked hard making it, Ymir.
Yamato: "Let me see, let me see!"
Ymir: "Oh, but you don't have to force yourself..."
Touya: "Yeah. Well, the shape's a bit odd, but it tastes good.
Yamato: "H-Hey, can I have some too?"
But thank you. It's because Sisk
Sisk: "Hee hee hee. Actually, there's a secret ingredient."
Touya: "H-Hey, Yama... Ugh, me too... Ghh..."
Sisk: "Ymir, love is something you have to seize for yourself!
All right, I'm leaving the rest to you."
Touya: "Huh...? I... I was eating your lunch, Ymir,
and I... Did I fall asleep...?"
Touya: "I see... Sorry, after you went to all that trouble making it.
Ymir: "Yeah... But you looked so peaceful asleep."
Touya: "...Were you there the whole time?"
Yamato: "Oh, good morning... Huh? Why was I
Ymir: "I've got something to discuss with Sisk now,
Yamato: "...Oh, Touya, there's something on your lips."
Touya: "I'm sorry, after you went to all that trouble making it."
I'm sorry we turned up so suddenly. See you."
Yamato: "...She went to all that trouble making it...
You just can't be honest, can you?"
